items.summary: Update: now rated critical. pfSense CE 2.4.5 through 2.9.0 and Plus through 26.07 contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated WebGUI users with Advanced Admin Access privilege to execute commands as root via Login Protection settings. Attackers can submit sshguard threshold, block time, or detection time values containing newlines or $(...) that are written unvalidated to sshguard.conf and sou...

items.title: CVE-2023-5824: Red Hat denial of service in Squid web proxy (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Squid, the web proxy shipped in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 and several of its update streams, can be made to stall or crash its worker process. An attacker can cause this denial of service remotely, without logging in, when a large cached HTTP response header is read back from disk.

items.title: CVE-2026-1324: Operation and Maintenance Management System command injection in SSH session handling (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Sangfor Operation and Maintenance Management System contains an OS command injection flaw in its SSH protocol session handling, where manipulating the keypassword argument lets an attacker run operating system commands. The attack can be launched remotely over the network by someone with low-privilege login access.

items.title: CVE-2022-26019: pfSense CE and pfSense Plus arbitrary command execution via NTP GPS settings (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Improper access control in pfSense CE and pfSense Plus lets a remote attacker who already holds the privilege to change NTP GPS settings rewrite existing files on the system, which may lead to arbitrary command execution. The attacker reaches it over the network after logging in with low-level access and needs no action from a user.

items.title: CVE-2022-26151: Command injection in mobile management server (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Citrix XenMobile Server has a command injection flaw that lets an attacker insert and run commands on the affected system. An attacker can reach it remotely over the network, but only after logging in with high-level privileges.

items.title: CVE-2023-46846: Squid: request/response smuggling in http/1.1 and icap (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Squid, as shipped in several Red Hat Enterprise Linux products, mishandles chunked encoding in HTTP/1.1 and ICAP traffic. A remote attacker can send smuggled requests and responses over the network, without logging in or any user action, to bypass firewall and frontend security systems.

items.title: CVE-2025-34024: Edimax EW-7438RPn Mini OS Command Injection via mp.asp (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. The Edimax EW-7438RPn Mini firmware has an OS command injection flaw in its mp.asp form handler. A network attacker who has logged in with low privileges can inject shell metacharacters into the command parameter and run arbitrary commands as root.

items.title: CVE-2025-34029: Edimax EW-7438RPn Mini OS Command Injection via syscmd.asp (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. The Edimax EW-7438RPn Mini firmware has an OS command injection flaw in its syscmd.asp form handler. A remote attacker with a low-privilege login can run arbitrary shell commands as the root user.

items.title: CVE-2026-136835: Jenkins Script Security Plugin sandbox escape in @Builder annotation handling (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. The Jenkins Script Security Plugin does not reject certain @Builder annotations that name an arbitrary class when the annotation is referred to by a partially qualified name. An attacker who can define and run sandboxed scripts, including Pipelines, can use this to execute code outside the sandbox if a suitable class is on the classpath of the component that evaluates the script.

items.title: CVE-2026-114713: UnrealIRCd remote command injection in labeled-response module (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. The labeled-response module in UnrealIRCd 6.0.0 (before the 6.2.7.1 fix) fails to escape the IRCv3 "label" message tag, so any user on a network with two or more linked servers can, remotely and without logging in, inject server-to-server commands that run with server authority. Because the bug requires a network with at least two linked servers, it is not limited to a single standalone server.

items.title: CVE-2026-131914、約18年前のASP.NET向けCSRF対策ライブラリの脆弱性が悪用。公式修正版なし
items.summary: 最後のリリースが2008年12月だったASP.NET向けのIdunno.AntiCsrfで脆弱性の悪用が確認された。公式修正版は公開されておらず、利用組織にはCSRF対策の置き換えと過去の侵害の有無の調査が求められる。

items.title: Thunderbird 161.0公開、CVE-2026-136226（OpenPGP署名付きメールの差出人偽装）を修正
items.summary: Thunderbird 161.0と延長サポート版153.8.0 ESRが公開された。OpenPGP署名の検証対象と差出人表示が食い違う致命的な欠陥を修正。IMAP接続を介したメールやフォルダーの変更・削除につながる問題にも対処した。

items.title: PAN-OS、CVE-2026-46300（Fragnesia）を修正。実際に悪用されたLinuxカーネル脆弱性
items.summary: Palo Alto Networksはファイアウォール向けOSのPAN-OSで、Linuxカーネルの権限昇格脆弱性Fragnesiaを修正した。既知の攻撃経路を遮断するPHP2Shell対策に続き、カーネル側の欠陥にも対応した。

items.title: Podatność w oprogramowaniu LiteSpeed Cache Plugin for Prestashop
items.summary: W oprogramowaniu LiteSpeed Cache Plugin for Prestashop wykryto podatność polegającą na braku weryfikacji przekazanego parametru (CVE-2026-129968).

items.title: Podatność w ASSA ABLOY Seawing SC-1000 WebConfig
items.summary: W ASSA ABLOY Seawing SC-1000 WebConfig została znaleziona podatność umożliwiającą zdalne wstrzyknięcie komend (CVE-2026-97180).

items.title: USN-9200-1: elfutils vulnerabilities
items.summary: It was discovered that elfutils incorrectly handled memory when processing certain malformed DWARF data. If a user or automated system were tricked into running readelf on a specially crafted file, an attacker could possibly use this issue to cause readelf to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or execute arbitrary code. If a user or automated system were tricked into running strip on a specially crafted file, an attacker could possibly use…

items.summary: Adam Bedard discovered that libXrender incorrectly handled certain responses from an X server, resulting in a heap buffer overflow. If a user were tricked into connecting to a malicious X server, an attacker could possibly use this issue to cause applications using libXrender to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2026-88807) Tobias Stoeckmann discovered that libXrender did not correctly validate lengths in responses from an X server. An attacker controlling an X server could possibly use these issues to cause applications using libXrender to crash, resulti…

An attacker on the local network segment can exploit this vulnerability by performing Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) spoofing to serve a malicious rootfs or intercept sensitive data, including SSH keys and secrets, from the Ignition configuration. items.title: CVE-2026-71296
items.summary: A flaw was found in maestro. A remote attacker could exploit a misconfiguration in the gRPC server where authentication defaults to a 'mock' mode. This default setting bypasses all authentication and authorization, allowing an unauthorized attacker to write resource bundles. Consequently, this could lead to arbitrary code execution on managed clusters.

items.title: CVE-2026-137079
items.summary: libvorbis through 1.3.7 contains a stack buffer overflow vulnerability in _ov_getlap() in lib/vorbisfile.c that passes a negative sample count from vorbis_synthesis_lapout() to memcpy(). Attackers can supply a short, valid Ogg Vorbis file with suitable block sizes to overwrite stack frames and crash applications performing two consecutive lapped seeks.

items.title: CVE-2026-137063
items.summary: Leptonica 1.79.0 through 1.87.0 contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in l_byteaInitFromStream() that allows attackers to write past a heap buffer by supplying oversized input. Attackers can provide a file larger than 1,000,000,000 bytes, causing l_byteaCreate() to allocate a 201-byte buffer before memcpy copies the full stream size, crashing the application.

items.title: CVE-2026-136831
items.summary: A vulnerability was determined in WPExperts New User Approve Plugin up to 3.3 on WordPress. Impacted is the function update_user_role of the file includes/end-points/class-users-api.php of the component REST API. Executing a manipulation can lead to missing authorization. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: CVE-2026-137089
items.summary: merge-deep-composed through 0.1.4 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability in _mergeDeepOne() that allows remote attackers to modify Object.prototype by supplying __proto__ keys. Attackers can pass JSON-parsed input containing __proto__ as a merge source to inject inherited properties, causing logic bypass or denial of service in Node.js processes.

items.title: CVE-2026-137062

Attackers can trigger TrashCan::destroyEntity() through the conversion actions to force-delete soft-deleted children, revisions and attachments, including content deleted by other users, preventing restoration.

items.title: CVE-2026-137061
items.summary: Wallos before 5.11.2 contains an infinite loop vulnerability that allows authenticated users or API key holders to exhaust server resources by storing subscriptions with a frequency of 0. Attackers can trigger renew.php or get_monthly_cost.php to loop forever on a P0D interval, pinning PHP workers and hanging the next-payment cron job for all users.

items.title: CVE-2026-136823

Performing a manipulation of the argument fpath results in os command injection. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used.

items.title: CVE-2026-133445
items.summary: In gdm3 before 51.2, an improper privilege management vulnerability allows an unprivileged local attacker with an active GDM graphical session to execute arbitrary code as root by supplying a malicious environment variable during session reauthentication.

items.title: CVE-2026-136822
items.summary: A vulnerability has been found in D-Link R32 1.10B02. The impacted element is the function SetDeviceSettings of the file /usr/bin/httpd of the component DHMAPI Action Handler. Such manipulation of the argument TZLocation leads to os command injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.

items.title: CVE-2026-67209
items.summary: metasfresh through 5.175 contains a SQL injection vulnerability in the stressTest_massCacheInvalidation handler of DebugRestController, which concatenates the caller-supplied tableName request parameter into SELECT statements without parameterization or validation and only checks that the caller is authenticated. Authenticated WebUI users with any role can send GET requests to /rest/api/debug/stressTest/massCacheInvalidation with SQL in the tableName parameter to run time-based and error-based blind queries against the PostgreSQL database, extracting sensitive ERP data such as user credentials…

items.title: CVE-2026-102957
items.summary: z_impl_pwm_capture_cycles() in drivers/pwm/pwm_capture.c stores its capture context (struct z_pwm_capture_cb_data, including a struct k_sem) on its own stack and registers a pointer to it as the driver capture callback's user_data. When called with a K_NO_WAIT timeout, k_sem_take() returns -EBUSY, which the function did not handle: it fell through, returned the uninitialized status field, copied uninitialized period/pulse values to the caller when that status happened to be zero, and returned without disabling the capture or clearing the callback. pwm_capture_cycles() is a system call, and z_v…

items.title: CVE-2026-90592
items.summary: The ITE it51xxx I2C driver, when operating as an I2C target (slave) in buffer mode (CONFIG_I2C_TARGET + CONFIG_I2C_TARGET_BUFFER_MODE), transmits response data from the fixed-size data->target_out_buffer inside its target FIFO interrupt handler target_i2c_isr_fifo() in drivers/i2c/i2c_ite_it51xxx.c. On every data interrupt of a host read transaction the handler pushes a fixed 16 bytes from target_out_buffer[i + data->r_index] into the hardware FIFO and then advances data->r_index by 16, without ever checking that index against the size of the buffer. data->r_index is reset to zero only on a ST…

items.title: CVE-2026-135487
items.summary: Munshi (by Petpooja) before 2026-07-15 contained a stored HTML injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to store markup in the profile full_name field by submitting a modified request directly to the backend, which persists the value without sanitization. The Contact Support workflow later inserts the stored name into the generated support email without HTML encoding, so attackers can make injected HTML and media, such as misleading banners, masked hyperlinks and external tracking resources, render in support messages received by the support team.

items.title: CVE-2026-137093
items.summary: Assimp before 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in MD5Importer::LoadMD5MeshFile() that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory via unvalidated weight ranges and bone indices. Attackers can supply a crafted .md5mesh file with out-of-range mBone values to increment heap words past the piCount allocation, causing memory corruption, out-of-bounds reads, or crashes.

items.title: CVE-2026-137092
items.summary: Assimp before 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in MD5Importer::MakeDataUnique() that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory by supplying unvalidated face indices. Attackers can craft an .md5mesh file with out-of-range face vertex indices or unfilled faces to set bits past the abHad allocation, read vertex data out of bounds, or crash the application.

items.title: CVE-2026-137091
items.summary: EverOS before 1.8.0 contains a cross-origin local file disclosure vulnerability that allows malicious websites to read local files by abusing a wildcard CORS policy with credentials and unrestricted file:// ingestion. Attackers can host JavaScript that calls POST /api/v2/memory/add with file:// URIs, then read parsed contents via POST /api/v2/memory/search to exfiltrate SSH keys, credentials, and alter or delete memories.

items.title: CVE-2026-137090
items.summary: build-git-clone before 1.0.4 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in the clone() function that allows attackers to execute commands by supplying crafted repository URLs. Attackers can embed shell metacharacters such as ; or $() in the url argument, which is concatenated into a sh -c command, to execute operating system commands with Node.js process privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-137088
items.summary: @oleksii-pavlov/deep-merge before 1.2.4 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability in deepMergeTwoAssignable() that allows remote attackers to modify Object.prototype by supplying a __proto__ key. Attackers can pass JSON-parsed input to deepMerge(), deepMergeAndAssign(), deepUpdate() or deepUpdateAndAssign() to inject inherited properties, causing logic bypass or denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-137087
items.summary: @irrelon/path 6.2.2 before 7.0.3 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability in merge() and mergeImmutable() that allows remote attackers to modify Object.prototype by supplying __proto__ keys. Attackers can pass untrusted JSON containing __proto__ or constructor.prototype payloads to merged objects, causing property injection, authorization bypass, or denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-137085
items.summary: ProjeQtOr before 13.1.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in tool/getAFieldForAClassById.php that allows authenticated low-privilege users to read any object property. Attackers can request Class=User with an administrator id and field=password or email to retrieve password hashes for offline cracking.

items.title: CVE-2026-137083
items.summary: OpenCV 3.0.0 through 4.14.0 and 5.0.0 through 5.1.0 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the built-in MJPEG encoder when writing grayscale frames due to incorrect level shifting in convertToYUV(). Attackers controlling pixel content written as grayscale MJPEG video can trigger unchecked cat_table and huff_dc_tab lookups, leaking adjacent or uninitialized memory into the output file or crashing the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-137082
items.summary: GNOME libxml2 through 2.15.4 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in xmlParseStartTag2() that allows attackers to crash applications by triggering parser context reuse after SAX1 parsing. Attackers can supply documents with attributes parsed first with XML_PARSE_SAX1 and then without it on a reused context, causing writes to unallocated ctxt->attallocs and denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-137080
items.summary: libical 4.0.0 before 4.0.7 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in icalrecur_iterator_set_range() that allows attackers to cause denial of service by supplying crafted recurrence rules. Attackers can provide a calendar whose recurrence rule is iterated over a reverse range, causing the loop to never terminate and spin the calling thread at full CPU indefinitely.

items.title: CVE-2026-137078
items.summary: Xiph.Org libvorbis through 1.3.7 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in ov_time_tell() in lib/vorbisfile.c that reads vf->vi[-1].rate after a failed seek leaves vf->pcm_offset at -1. Attackers can supply a crafted Ogg Vorbis file with a corrupted page to applications that seek and query playback time, leaking heap bytes via the returned value or crashing the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-137076
items.summary: FFmpeg through 9.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability because avcodec_flush_buffers() does not release the decoder context's frame buffer pool, so recycled buffers retain prior picture data. Attackers can supply crafted damaged streams to applications reusing one decoder context across users to recover another user's decoded picture content from unwritten frame regions.

items.title: CVE-2026-137074
items.summary: GNOME libxml2 2.12.6 through 2.15.4 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in xmlTextReaderConstEncoding() after a reader is reset with xmlReaderNewWalker(). Because xmlCtxtReset() leaves ctxt->input NULL, querying the document encoding makes xmlGetActualEncoding() read ctxt->input->flags without a check, crashing the application and causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-137073
items.summary: GNOME libxml2 through 2.15.4 contains a double free vulnerability in xmlReaderNewWalker() that frees reader->input again after xmlTextReaderClose() already released it. Applications reusing a closed xmlTextReader with xmlReaderNewWalker() can crash, and groomed heap memory can control the close callback for possible code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-137072
items.summary: GNOME libxml2 2.9.10 through 2.15.4 contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows attackers to trigger stale DTD validation states after xmlTextReaderCurrentDoc documents are freed. Attackers can supply an XML document ending with an error inside an element, causing xmlTextReaderClose to read freed element declarations, leading to crashes and possible invalid frees.

items.title: CVE-2026-137071
items.summary: Boost.JSON 1.84.0 through 1.92.0 contains an information exposure vulnerability because parser_for reset() does not reset nested parse_into handlers, retaining state across documents. Attackers controlling an abandoned or subsequent document parsed by a reused parser_for can cause partial string data from one document to appear in another's result.

items.title: CVE-2026-137070
items.summary: GEOS 3.13.0 before 3.15.1 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in RectangleContains::isContainedInBoundary that recurses indefinitely on curved geometries returned by getGeometryN. Attackers can supply crafted WKT or WKB CircularString, CompoundCurve, or CurvePolygon geometries tested via PreparedGeometry::contains or GEOSPreparedContains against a prepared rectangle to crash the process with a stack overflow.

items.title: CVE-2026-137069
items.summary: libxml2 2.13.0 through 2.15.4 contains a denial of service vulnerability because xmlTextReaderSetup does not reset reader->state when a reader is reused. Attackers can submit one malformed XML document to an application reusing a single reader, causing every later document to be rejected until the reader is recreated.

items.title: CVE-2026-137068
items.summary: libxml2 through 2.15.4 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability that allows attackers to crash applications by triggering xmlFreeNode on a stale reader->faketext node after xmlTextReader reuse. Attackers can supply XML containing a namespace declaration to applications that read its value and reuse the reader, causing a freed document's dictionary read and process crash.

items.title: CVE-2026-137067
items.summary: GNOME libxml2 2.9.10 through 2.15.4 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in xmlValidatePopElement because xmlCtxtReset frees the DTD without popping stale validation states. Attackers supplying an XML document ending inside an element to an application reusing a DTD-validating xmlTextReader can trigger heap reads, causing crashes and limited heap disclosure via error messages.

items.title: CVE-2026-137065
items.summary: Chatwoot before 4.20.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows account administrators to attach integration hooks to other accounts' inboxes by supplying a foreign inbox_id. Attackers can create a Dialogflow hook referencing a victim inbox, leaving its new conversations stuck as pending awaiting a bot, and enumerate inbox IDs to disclose inbox names.

items.title: CVE-2026-137060
items.summary: paramz through 0.10.0 contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability that allows attackers to execute code by supplying crafted model files to paramz.load(), which calls pickle.load() without restrictions. Attackers can embed objects whose __reduce__ method returns callables like exec or os.system in shared paramz or GPy model files to run code with the victim's privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-137056
items.summary: DeepSeek-Reasonix before 2.53.0 contains a command execution vulnerability that allows attackers to run commands without user approval because the shellsafe classifier treats git blame and git whatchanged as read-only. Attackers can plant a diff textconv driver in .gitattributes and .git/config so that git blame, triggered via prompt injection or routine use, executes attacker-chosen commands with the user's privileges, exposing stored provider API keys and session history.

items.title: CVE-2026-136733
items.summary: A weakness has been identified in EduardoPires EquinoxProject up to 1.10. This vulnerability affects the function BuildToken of the file src/Equinox.Services.Api/appsettings.Development.json of the component JWT Bearer Authentication. This manipulation of the argument SecretKey with the input fmFGn5agHZkuG2N0e1zaEJIQtGVoNN5P causes hard-coded credentials. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

items.title: CVE-2026-133467
items.summary: CodeSafe is an open-source Python library for code encryption, decryption, and safe evaluation using Python's AST module. From versions 0.0.1 through 0.0.4, the safe_eval() function can be bypassed with indirect subscript calls such as builtins'exec', because AST validation blocks only direct calls to dangerous built-ins. An attacker who controls an expression passed to safe_eval() can execute arbitrary Python code with the permissions of the host application. This issue is fixed in version 0.0.5.

items.title: CVE-2026-135636
items.summary: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 18.0 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and 19.6 before 19.6.2 that under certain conditions could have allowed an authenticated user to send requests to internal network resources due to insufficient validation in repository import.

items.title: CVE-2026-133465
items.summary: Glances is an open-source system cross-platform monitoring tool. In versions prior to 4.5.7, the on-alert action command tokenizer in secure.py treats quote characters as argument boundaries without escaping. A monitored stat value, such as a mount point name, that is quoted in an action command template can contain a quote character that breaks out of its quote boundary and injects additional arguments into the process the action invokes. No shell operator is needed for this attack. This issue has been fixed in version 4.5.7.

items.title: CVE-2026-132822
items.summary: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 11.7 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and 19.6 before 19.6.2 that under certain conditions could have allowed an authenticated user with Maintainer-role permissions to cause denial of service due to missing resource limits in the error tracking integration.

items.title: CVE-2026-81406
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the read_db2_packet function of the db2-das-info.nse script, which trusts an unmasked 32-bit length field supplied by the server. A malicious DB2 Administration Server on a scanned host can declare a packet length of up to roughly 4.29GB, causing the script to buffer that much data and the Nmap process to exhaust memory; the script runs during version detection (-sV).

items.title: CVE-2026-81405
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the Comm.ReceivePacket function of the NSE rpc.lua library, which buffers ONC-RPC record fragments using the server-declared fragment length without an upper bound. A malicious RPC service on a scanned host can declare fragments of up to roughly 2.1GB, and up to 400 fragments per call, causing the Nmap process to exhaust memory; the read path is reached by rpcinfo.nse during version detection (-sV) and is shared by the NFS, rusers and NetWorker scripts.

items.title: CVE-2026-81414
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the sendPacketsTCP function of the NSE dns.lua library, which reads a DNS-over-TCP response without a size limit and builds it by repeated string concatenation. A malicious DNS server on a scanned host can stream unbounded data in response to the initial SOA lookup made by dns-zone-transfer.nse, before any AXFR request is sent, causing unbounded memory growth and quadratic CPU cost in the Nmap process.

items.title: CVE-2026-81413
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the inline AXFR response reader of the dns-zone-transfer.nse script, which reads the zone transfer response without a size limit. A malicious DNS server on a scanned host can stream unbounded data over TCP port 53 after the AXFR request, causing the memory of the Nmap process to grow at the attacker's send rate until it is exhausted.

items.title: CVE-2026-136725
items.summary: A vulnerability was identified in slowlyo owl-admin up to 4.7.7. Affected by this issue is the function fillModelFromData of the file src/Services/AdminService.php. The manipulation of the argument id/remember_token/enabled leads to dynamically-determined object attributes. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. Upgrading to version 4.7.8 can resolve this issue. The identifier of the patch is 9b0c98dc3e2710b2ba8d7579da89ec6a4042fcc8. It is advisable to upgrade the affected component.

items.title: CVE-2026-136724
items.summary: A vulnerability was detected in slowlyo owl-admin up to 4.7.7. The impacted element is the function update of the file src/Services/AdminUserService.php of the component Admin User Management. The manipulation results in missing authorization. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. Upgrading to version 4.7.8 is sufficient to resolve this issue. The patch is identified as 70910338c1e136d5bdd6ed795768e7a81445f422. The affected component should be upgraded.

items.title: CVE-2026-135486
items.summary: Munshi (by Petpooja) before 2026-07-07 contained a broken object level authorization vulnerability in the PUT /api/invoice/{invoice_id}/extracted-data endpoint, which accepts a client-supplied extracted_data object without verifying invoice ownership, enforcing the invoice_edit permission or checking whether the invoice has been soft deleted. Authenticated attackers who know an invoice identifier can overwrite seller and buyer details, invoice identifiers, product entries, totals and custom metadata of invoices, including archived invoices marked is_deleted = 1, undermining the integrity of fi…

items.title: CVE-2026-133463
items.summary: SeaweedFS is a distributed storage system for files and blobs. Prior to version 4.46, the S3 gateway does not evaluate bucket policies on POST Object uploads, which are multipart/form-data POST requests to the bucket. An authenticated S3 identity that a bucket policy restricts, such as to a key prefix or by source IP, can create or overwrite objects it is denied by sending the upload as a POST instead of a PUT. This issue has been fixed in version 4.46.

items.title: CVE-2026-135092
items.summary: PDF::API2 versions before 2.049 for Perl allow unbounded recursion via circular cross-reference chains in readxrtr. When a PDF is opened, readxrtr reads each cross-reference table and calls itself on the offset in the trailer's /Prev entry. Nothing records which offsets it has already read, so a /Prev entry pointing back to an earlier table, or to its own, makes it recurse without end. An attacker who supplies a crafted PDF can cause a denial of service in any application that opens it.

items.title: CVE-2022-50996
items.summary: WWW::Form::UrlEncoded::XS versions before 0.28 for Perl write past the end of the Perl argument stack when parse_urlencoded returns many pairs. parse_urlencoded returns its result as a list, pushing each decoded key and value onto the argument stack without first extending the stack to fit them. parse_urlencoded_arrayref returns an array reference and is not affected. A remote client that sends a query string or request body with many pairs to an application parsing it with parse_urlencoded can corrupt memory and crash the process.

items.title: CVE-2022-50995
items.summary: WWW::Form::UrlEncoded::XS versions before 0.27 for Perl read one byte before the input buffer when parsing an empty string. parse_urlencoded and parse_urlencoded_arrayref check for a trailing "&" or ";" by reading the last byte of the input, without first checking that the input has any bytes. A remote client that sends an empty query string or request body to an application parsing it with this module can crash the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-99808
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: Bluetooth: L2CAP: Use default TxWindow for zero socket option L2CAP_OPTIONS accepts a txwin_size of zero and stores it in tx_win. The zero is then sent to the peer in our configuration request, and if the channel ends up in ERTM mode it is passed to l2cap_seq_list_init(). Use the default TxWindow instead, as the mode can still be changed to ERTM during configuration.

items.title: CVE-2026-99807
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: Bluetooth: L2CAP: Reject invalid TxWindow in configuration requests A peer can send an ERTM RFC option with a TxWindow of zero, which is out of spec. It is stored in remote_tx_win unchanged and later passed to l2cap_seq_list_init(), where roundup_pow_of_two(0) is undefined. On some architectures this results in a ZERO_SIZE_PTR list and a remote kernel oops. A TxWindow above 63 is out of spec as well. With 6-bit sequence numbers we would then send more unacknowledged frames than the sequence space can tell apart. Reply with L2C…

items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: Bluetooth: L2CAP: Reject mode changes on connected channels A peer can send a configuration response with an RFC option for another mode to a connected channel, for example to switch it from Streaming to ERTM mode. l2cap_parse_conf_rsp() then changes chan->mode, but l2cap_ertm_init() is not called again, so the ERTM sequence lists are never allocated. The next out-of-sequence I-frame makes l2cap_seq_list_clear() write through the NULL srej_list.list. Refuse the channel when a response tries to change the mode of a connected ch…

items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: net: limit priority VLAN untag depth The priority VLAN receive path can repeatedly remove VID 0 tags and retry packet processing. Unlike the read-only VLAN protocol parser, this path has no limit on the number of nested tags it consumes. Each skb_vlan_untag() advances skb->data and resets header offsets. The offsets are stored in 16-bit fields. With enough nested tags, the network or transport offset can wrap. A later protocol handler can then derive a large pull length from the wrapped offsets and access memory outside the sk…

items.title: CVE-2026-136515
items.summary: psqlODBC rewrites statement text for keyset-driven cursors and ODBC escapes using positions it found in the text. These positions could lie outside the text or describe another statement: - After SQLExecDirect() failed on a statement handle, the FROM and WHERE positions of the failed statement were applied to the next, shorter statement on that handle. - The parser could record a FROM position with no text after it, and the rewrite then copied a negative length. - An {fn …} escape whose arguments contain FOR UPDATE, ; or INTO … FROM made the driver remove a cursor prefix from the wrong buffer.…

items.title: CVE-2026-136514
items.summary: psqlODBC assumed that a table it reads keeps the definition it had when the statement was described or parsed. A database user who owns a table or view another user's application reads can crash that application, with an honest server and default options, in these cases: - Columns dropped or added in another session while the application updates rows through an updatable cursor, or describes the columns with Parse=1. - A view whose ctid is NULL, read through an updatable cursor, which writes past the row cache, and a view with a volatile filter scrolled backward with UseDeclareFetch=1. - Rows…

items.title: CVE-2026-136511
items.summary: psqlODBC mapped an SSLmode value in a connection string that it did not recognise, such as SSLmode=Require, SSLmode=Verify-Full, SSLmode={require} or SSLmode={verify-full}, to disable. SQLDriverConnect() then returned SQL_SUCCESS with no diagnostic, and the connection was not encrypted. An attacker on the network path of such a connection can read and change its traffic. Versions up to and including psqlODBC 18.00.0006 are affected.

items.title: CVE-2026-136510
items.summary: A parameter-array execution that fails part-way leaves the rows it has already queued on the statement handle, and the next execution on that handle sends them. After a data-at-execution batch is abandoned, by SQLCancel or a rejected SQLPutData, the next SQLExecDirect sends the failed batch's rows and returns SQL_SUCCESS without sending its own statement. So an application that logs the failure on the same handle has its log entry turned into a silent no-op, while rows it was told had failed are stored. An end user who controls one value in an application's array insert can arrange both halves…

items.summary: psqlODBC did not check that a server reply matches the query it sent: that a FETCH returns no more rows than it asked for, that each row has the described number of columns, that one query produces one result, and that a COPY, a transaction or the connection ends where the protocol says. By sending replies that do not match, a hostile or compromised server, or anyone on the network path of a connection that does not use sslmode=verify-full (the default is disable) can corrupt memory in the application: - A FETCH reply with more rows than requested overflows the row cache. - Extra results in re…

items.summary: psqlODBC builds queries of its own from names, and put these names into them without escaping or qualification: - the database name in SQLForeignKeys(); - the current schema name in catalog functions; - the table name in the currtid2() call that re-reads rows of updatable cursors; - column names in the inserts and updates of SQLSetPos() and SQLBulkOperations(); - cursor names set with SQLSetCursorName() or returned as refcursors (FetchRefcursors=1); - parameter names (SQL_DESC_NAME) in procedure calls; - the = operator in an OID comparison in SQLColumns(), which the server resolves through sea…

items.summary: psqlODBC uses sizes and counts without checking their range, or keeps them in types too small for them: - A row array size of 0, set with SQLSetStmtAttr() or on the ARD, makes SQLSetPos() with SQL_REFRESH write past the bound arrays. - SQL_DESC_COUNT above 32767 on an APD or IPD writes before the start of a heap buffer. - A numeric parameter with a negative scale overflows a stack buffer. - SQLGetData() of a text value of 2 GiB or more into a wide-character buffer computes a wrapped size and overflows the heap. - The 16-bit reference count and size of the statement parser's column-information…

items.summary: psqlODBC frees memory that is still in use, frees it twice, or writes outside an application buffer in these cases: - The clean-up the driver runs at commit and rollback sends queries of its own, and the reply to one of them can start the clean-up again while it is running. items.title: CVE-2026-136502
items.summary: psqlODBC scans statement text itself to substitute parameters, translate ODBC escapes, join batched statements and rewrite queries for updatable cursors. Where it read the text differently from the server, text the driver took for data ran as SQL, or a positioned write went to another table: - An escape string constant written e'…' in lower case was not recognised as one, and '…' after a keyword ending in E, as in LIKE'…', was taken for one. - A } inside a quoted literal ended an ODBC {d …}, {t …}, {ts …} or {escape …} sequence. - Dollar-quote tags containing _ were not recognised, and an iden…

items.summary: To build positioned updates and to describe columns, psqlODBC matches the names in a statement against the catalog. Where it matched differently from the server, it used another table or column: - Table and schema names were compared case-insensitively in its column-information cache, so users could be taken for another user's "Users", and the driver then evaluated that table's column default to answer @@IDENTITY. - In FROM ONLY t, ONLY was taken for the table name. - Column names were compared case-insensitively, so with Parse=1 the type of another column could decide the size of the applicat…

items.title: CVE-2026-136499
items.summary: psqlODBC read memory it had not written, or memory past the end of an application buffer, and sent it to the server or returned it to the application: - Text bound as SQL_C_CHAR to a large-object parameter was read past the end of the application's buffer, and the extra bytes were stored in the large object. - After a fetch truncated a long bytea or large-object value, positioned updates and inserts read past the bound buffer and wrote that memory into the row. - Hex text with a NUL byte, bound to a binary parameter with an explicit length, sent uninitialised heap memory as the parameter value…

items.title: CVE-2026-8748
items.summary: Crypt::JWT versions before 0.037_1 for Perl compare HMAC signatures and JWE authentication tags in non-constant time. decode_jwt compares HS256, HS384 and HS512 signatures, and the authentication tag of A128CBC-HS256, A192CBC-HS384 and A256CBC-HS512 encrypted tokens, against the computed value with Perl's eq operator. Its run time depends on the number of matching leading bytes. Attackers controlling merge keys like '__proto__:isAdmin' or nested __proto__ properties can inject properties into Object.prototype, altering application logic or causing errors.

items.title: CVE-2026-136920
items.summary: OneDev before 17.2.4 contains an argument injection vulnerability in commit query handling that allows authenticated attackers to inject git options through branch or tag names. Attackers can push a branch named like --output= and query it via the commits page or REST API to overwrite server-writable files, causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-136917
items.summary: Part-DB (Part-DB-server) before 2.20.6 contains an open redirect vulnerability in several controllers that pass user-supplied _redirect or redirect_back parameters to redirect() without validating local paths. Attackers can craft links to endpoints like /tools/batch_eda_edit using scheme-relative or protocol-relative values that bypass the nelmio_security guard, sending authenticated victims to attacker-controlled phishing sites.

items.title: CVE-2026-136914
items.summary: JuggleIM im-server before 1.8.17 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to invoke the internal g_del_members operation by supplying it as a client topic. Attackers holding a valid connect token can send crafted WebSocket or HTTP publish requests with arbitrary group and member ids to remove any users from any group in the application.

items.title: CVE-2026-136913
items.summary: JuggleIM im-server before 1.8.17 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated end users to invoke the internal upd_user_info operation because ImListenerImpl.PublishArrived forwards any client-supplied topic as the RPC method. Attackers holding a valid connect token can supply another user's id to UpdUserInfo to overwrite that user's nickname, portrait, extension fields and settings.

items.title: CVE-2026-136910
items.summary: POCO C++ Libraries through 1.15.4 contain a denial of service vulnerability in InflatingStreamBuf::reset() that fails to clear stale buffered data from a previous failed stream. Attackers can supply one corrupt compressed stream to an application reusing an InflatingOutputStream, causing subsequent valid streams to fail decompression.

items.title: CVE-2026-136909
items.summary: Assimp 5.1.0 through 6.0.6 contains a memory leak vulnerability in AMFImporter::ParseFile that overwrites the previous XML parser pointer without releasing it. Attackers can supply repeated AMF files to applications using a long-lived Assimp::Importer to retain parsed documents and exhaust memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-136908
items.summary: libyang through 6.4.13 contains a release of invalid pointer vulnerability in ly_in_memory() and ly_in_memory_chunk() in src/in.c that return the current read position instead of the previous start address. Attackers supplying YANG data parsed from a heap buffer can cause applications freeing the returned pointer to pass an interior address to free(), aborting the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-136907
items.summary: CESNET libyang through 6.4.13 contains a return of wrong status code vulnerability in ly_in_filepath() in src/in.c that reports success when a new file cannot be opened or mapped. Attackers who make an application switch a reused input handler to a nonexistent or empty file cause it to parse the previously loaded file's data as the requested input.

items.title: CVE-2026-136905
items.summary: CESNET libyang through 6.4.13 contains an incomplete cleanup vulnerability in ly_out_reset() in src/out.c that tests a stale errno ESPIPE value after a successful seek. Applications reusing one output handler for different clients rewind but do not truncate the file, leaking leftover bytes of a previous client's output.

items.title: CVE-2026-136904
items.summary: POCO C++ Libraries through 1.15.4 contain a denial of service vulnerability in InflatingStreamBuf::reset() and InflatingInputStream::reset() that fails to discard unconsumed compressed input after decompression errors. Attackers can supply one corrupt zlib, gzip or zip-deflate stream to applications reusing an InflatingInputStream, causing all later stream reads, including valid ones, to fail.

items.title: CVE-2026-133464
items.summary: SeaweedFS is a distributed storage system for files and blobs. Prior to version 4.46, FileStore.ValidatePassword in the SFTP server does not reject zero-length secrets before comparing them, causing an empty login password to match any account configured without one, such as public-key-only or certificate-only users. Because password authentication is enabled by default, a remote attacker who knows a valid username can log in without a key or secret and obtain an SFTP session with that user's home directory and path permissions. This issue is fixed in version 4.46.

items.title: CVE-2026-135141
items.summary: A logic flaw in the query-building layer of the Mongoid object-document mapper causes a model-level default restriction that is meant to return no records to be silently discarded when it is combined into a query. A user with basic application privileges who sends an ordinary request may read, change, or remove records that the restriction was intended to withhold.

items.title: CVE-2026-135140
items.summary: Mongoid may omit a field from the client-side encryption settings it generates for a collection when that same field is also used as a reference to another record. The value is then stored in readable form instead of encrypted, and the application receives no indication that this has happened. A party with ordinary authenticated read access to the affected collection may be able to view data that was intended to be protected.

items.title: CVE-2026-135139
items.summary: Mongoid contains an incorrect authorization weakness in the handling of caller-supplied filters for bulk removal through a referenced association. Conditions already attached to the association can take precedence over the filter the caller supplied, so records the caller did not select may be removed. A user with basic privileges in an application built on the library may cause unintended removal of records belonging to the same parent record.

items.title: CVE-2026-135138
items.summary: Mongoid does not consistently apply its read-only attribute protection when attribute names are supplied dynamically by the caller. In an application that forwards caller-supplied attribute names into a document update, a user with basic application privileges may change values held inside a field the model declared immutable. This may result in unintended modification of data the application treats as trusted, such as flags used for its own access decisions.

items.title: CVE-2026-135135
items.summary: Mongoid builds an incomplete automatic encryption schema for certain embedded document associations. As a result, values that the application declared as encrypted may be written to the database in cleartext, with no error or warning returned to the application. A party holding only basic read privileges on the affected collection, and no access to the encryption keys, may then obtain those values in readable form.

items.title: CVE-2026-135225
items.summary: An information exposure weakness in the connection string handling of the MongoDB Ruby Driver can place credential material from the application's own configuration into the text of a parsing error, where an existing redaction control does not apply. A party able to read the application's error output or logs may thereby obtain database credential text together with deployment coordinates. The condition arises entirely within the embedding application process and requires no database authentication.

items.title: CVE-2026-135147
items.summary: A data-query neutralization weakness in the query builder of the MongoDB integration for a PHP web framework allows values supplied to certain bulk counter-update helpers to be interpreted by the database as query expressions rather than stored as plain text. An application that passes externally supplied data into these helpers may write unintended values into stored documents and may result in unintended disclosure of other data held on the same document. No credentials are required of the party supplying the value.

items.title: CVE-2026-135145
items.summary: A polymorphic relationship query helper in the MongoDB Eloquent integration for Laravel resolves a record's type identifier inconsistently between the code that stores a relationship link and the code that searches for one. An application that relies on a relationship-absence query to restrict which records a request may see or change can therefore have that restriction silently fail, allowing a user with basic application privileges to read and to modify or remove records the restriction was meant to cover.

items.title: CVE-2026-135144
items.summary: A query builder component in a MongoDB integration library for a PHP web framework does not run the query-modification callbacks that an application registers with the framework before sending read, update, and delete operations to the database. As a result, a filter that an application relies on to limit which records a request may touch can be omitted silently. items.title: CVE-2026-132145
items.summary: A flaw was found in rsyslog. An attacker who can redirect or intercept outbound network traffic and present a certificate issued by a trusted certificate authority could capture forwarded log data, leading to information disclosure.

items.title: CVE-2026-134646
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a cleartext transmission vulnerability in the SMTP service monitor that never issues STARTTLS because get_smtp_status tests an undefined $ssl variable. Passive network attackers can capture AUTH PLAIN credentials sent in plaintext each time a STARTTLS-configured monitor runs, without needing a Webmin login.

items.title: CVE-2026-134645
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in proc/trace.cgi that allows local unprivileged OS users to inject markup via unescaped process arguments and system call parameters. Attackers can craft process command lines or file names passed to open so that script executes in a Webmin user's session when they trace the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-134641
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in minecraft/save_backup.cgi that allows local attackers with write access to the Minecraft server directory to inject script via unescaped world directory names. Attackers can create a world directory containing HTML or script that executes in a Webmin user's session when they run Backup Now.

items.title: CVE-2026-134640
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in imap_login in mailboxes/folders-lib.pl that skips certificate verification and hostname checks for IMAP SSL connections. Man-in-the-middle attackers can present any certificate to capture IMAP credentials sent by the System and Server Status IMAP monitor and spoof monitor results.

items.title: CVE-2026-134638
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a missing integrity verification vulnerability in usermin/upgrade.cgi that downloads Usermin upgrade packages over plaintext HTTP without signature or digest checks. On-path network attackers or DNS spoofers can supply a malicious RPM, Debian, or tar.gz package whose maintainer scripts or setup.sh execute as root during upgrade.

items.title: CVE-2026-134637
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a STARTTLS downgrade vulnerability in send_mail in mailboxes/boxes-lib.pl that continues over plaintext when STARTTLS is rejected. Man-in-the-middle attackers can strip or reject STARTTLS to capture configured SMTP AUTH credentials, crackable CRAM-MD5 exchanges, and the content of sent mail.

items.title: CVE-2026-134636
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a weak randomness vulnerability that allows attackers to predict TOTP two-factor secrets generated by generate_base32_secret() using a time and PID seeded rand(). Attackers who know a user's password and estimate enrollment time can enumerate candidate seeds, reproduce the secret, and bypass the second authentication factor.

items.title: CVE-2026-134635
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in ldap-client/check.cgi that allows LDAP directory writers to execute commands via unquoted uid values. Attackers can create a posixAccount entry with shell metacharacters in its uid, executing commands as root when an administrator runs Check Configuration.

items.title: CVE-2026-134634
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in servers/link.cgi that accepts self-signed certificates for linked servers even when certificate checking is enabled. Man-in-the-middle attackers presenting a self-signed certificate with the correct hostname can capture stored HTTP Basic credentials for the remote Webmin and inject HTML into the local Webmin origin.

items.title: CVE-2026-134633
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in init/mass_systemd.cgi that prints unescaped journalctl output when a systemd service fails to start. Attackers can inject script into the journal via logger or sshd invalid user names, executing it in an administrator's Webmin session.

items.title: CVE-2026-134631
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in ldap-useradmin/edit_user.cgi that allows attackers to inject markup through the LDAP sambaAcctFlags and sambaBadPasswordCount attributes, which are rendered without HTML encoding. Attackers with LDAP write access to these attributes can store malicious scripts that execute in a Webmin administrator's browser when the user entry is opened in the editor.

items.title: CVE-2026-134629
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in mysql/index.cgi that renders MySQL connection error text and server version strings without escaping. Malicious MySQL server operators or on-path attackers on plaintext connections can return markup in error packets or version strings to execute JavaScript in Webmin user sessions.

items.title: CVE-2026-134628
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Disk Quotas module that allows directory administrators to inject markup via NSS user names. Attackers who can create or rename LDAP, NIS or SSSD identities owning blocks on XFS quota filesystems can execute script in the browser of administrators viewing quota/list_users.cgi.

items.title: CVE-2026-134627
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows local users or directory writers to inject script by placing markup in user names, group names or GECOS fields. Attackers can set GECOS via chfn or modify LDAP, NIS or SSSD entries so unescaped values in my_user_chooser.cgi, my_group_chooser.cgi, user_chooser.cgi and group_chooser.cgi execute in a Webmin user's browser.

items.title: CVE-2026-134463
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in switch_smtp_to_ssl in mailboxes/boxes-lib.pl and status/smtp-monitor.pl, which calls Net::SSLeay::connect without certificate verification or a hostname check. Man-in-the-middle attackers can present any certificate when SMTP with SSL or STARTTLS is configured to capture SMTP AUTH credentials and message content.

items.title: CVE-2026-134462
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in mount/nfs_export.cgi that allows malicious NFS servers to inject scripts through unescaped export paths. Attackers controlling or spoofing an NFS server's mountd replies can return crafted export paths that execute JavaScript in the session of a Webmin user browsing exports.

items.title: CVE-2026-134446
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a weak random password generation vulnerability in generate_random_password() that allows attackers to predict generated account passwords because seed_random() effectively seeds Perl rand() with only time XOR process ID. When the non-default random_password option is enabled and administrators keep the pre-filled password in edit_user.cgi, attackers can enumerate time and PID seeds to recover passwords and authenticate as new accounts.

items.title: CVE-2026-134445
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in status/edit_mon.cgi that allows attackers to inject scripts through unescaped monitor status descriptions. Malicious HTTP or FTPS server operators, on-path attackers, or local users creating crafted filenames in wildcard-monitored directories can execute JavaScript in a Webmin user's session.

items.title: CVE-2026-134444
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a cleartext transmission vulnerability in connect_ldap_db in ldap-server/ldap-server-lib.pl that sends the LDAP root DN password unencrypted when encryption is set to Detect automatically. Passive network attackers observing traffic between Webmin and a remote LDAP server can capture directory root credentials because the connection loop always reaches a plaintext bind attempt.

items.title: CVE-2026-134442
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in ldap-client/popup_browser.cgi that allows attackers to inject markup by storing it in LDAP attribute values printed without HTML encoding. Attackers with write access to an LDAP directory entry, needing no Webmin account, can execute scripts in the Webmin origin when an administrator browses that entry.

items.title: CVE-2026-134441
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Upload and Download module that allows attackers to inject script via unescaped HTTP status lines from background downloads. Attackers controlling a download server can return a malicious status line stored by updown/download.pl and printed unescaped by updown/index.cgi, executing script in a higher-privileged user's session.

items.title: CVE-2026-134440
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a Perl code injection vulnerability in cluster-useradmin/sync.cgi that allows attackers to run code by placing single quotes in home directory paths. Attackers with root on one managed host can craft a home path that breaks out of remote_eval() string literals during Sync, executing Perl as root on other managed hosts.

items.title: CVE-2026-134438
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains an insecure download vulnerability in webmin/upgrade.cgi, cluster-webmin/upgrade.cgi and cluster-usermin/upgrade.cgi that fetches upgrade packages over plaintext HTTP with GnuPG signature verification disabled by default. On-path network attackers can substitute a malicious RPM, Debian or tar.gz package during a default upgrade to execute code as root on the Webmin host and managed cluster servers.

items.title: CVE-2026-134437
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in ldap-server/edit_browser.cgi that allows attackers with write access to LDAP entry attributes to inject script by storing markup in attribute values. When an administrator browses the entry in the LDAP Server directory browser, the unencoded script runs in the Webmin origin, letting attackers act with the administrator's session.

items.title: CVE-2026-134368
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in lpadmin/list_jobs.cgi that allows local users or network IPP clients to inject script via CUPS print-job titles. Attackers can submit a print job with a crafted title, for example using lp -t, to execute script in a Printer Administration user's Webmin session.

items.title: CVE-2026-134333
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in mysql/view_table.cgi that allows MySQL users to inject scripts via unescaped column names. Attackers with CREATE or ALTER privilege can create columns containing HTML payloads that execute in a Webmin administrator's session when the table is viewed.

items.title: CVE-2026-134326
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a signature verification bypass vulnerability in webmin-lib.pl that allows attackers to install unsigned module updates when GnuPG setup fails. Attackers tampering with update downloads via network position or a custom update URL can supply malicious modules that run as root when administrators apply updates.

items.title: CVE-2026-134323
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in generic_ldap_connect in ldap-client-lib.pl that accepts any LDAPS or StartTLS server certificate. Man-in-the-middle attackers can impersonate the LDAP server to capture the bind DN password, often the root DN, and return forged directory data.

items.title: CVE-2026-134305
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in ldap-useradmin/raw.cgi that allows attackers with LDAP attribute write access to inject markup. Attackers can store script in user or group attributes or the dn, which executes in an administrator's browser when viewing the raw entry.

items.title: CVE-2026-134283
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in the http_download function of web-lib-funcs.pl that skips TLS chain and hostname verification. Man-in-the-middle attackers can present any certificate and substitute downloaded modules, themes, or catalog content, leading to root code execution or injected HTML.

items.title: CVE-2026-136632
items.summary: OpenProject 17.2.0 before 17.5.2, 17.6.0 before 17.6.1, 17.7.0 before 17.7.3, 17.8.0 before 17.8.2, and 17.9.0 before 17.9.7 contains an externally controlled method selection vulnerability in InplaceEditFieldsController via the unvalidated attribute parameter. Users who can view a project can request the inplace_edit_fields reset route with attribute destroy to delete projects and subprojects, or invoke other methods exposing restricted data.

items.title: CVE-2026-136629
items.summary: Nektos act 0.2.92 before 0.2.95 contains an argument injection vulnerability in readProjectArgsFile and projectFlag that allows malicious repositories to bypass the untrusted project .actrc flag allowlist. Attackers can commit a crafted .actrc smuggling disallowed flags like -P self-hosted or --privileged to run workflow steps on the developer's host.

items.title: CVE-2026-136625
items.summary: ai-memory 2.6.0 before 3.3.2 contains a symlink following vulnerability in the ai-memory-wikisync companion that allows local attackers to overwrite arbitrary files by planting symlinks at predictable temporary names. Attackers can place a .wikisync-tmp-.md symlink in a shared destination so atomic_write() truncates and overwrites its target with the victim's privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-136621
items.summary: LTplus-AG ifc-lite @ifc-lite/export before 4.13.1 and ifc-lite-export before 27.0.0 contain a STEP record injection vulnerability in the mutation writer via unescaped typed-value type names. Attackers controlling the mutations payload can place parentheses, semicolons, and newlines in typed.type to append arbitrary entity records to exported IFC files, bypassing the class-name guard.

items.title: CVE-2026-136620
items.summary: pain001-mcp 0.0.72 before 0.0.80 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the commit_payment_batch MCP tool that allows attackers to write files outside any output directory via output_file_path. Attackers can stage a batch, reuse the self-issued confirmation_token, and supply absolute, dot-dot, or symlinked paths to create or overwrite server-writable files with generated XML.

items.title: CVE-2026-136619
items.summary: Karakeep before 0.35.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows shared-list collaborators to learn other users' private favourited and archived bookmark state through filter queries. Viewer or editor collaborators can call bookmarks.getBookmarks on a shared list with favourited or archived set to true, inferring owners' private flags from which bookmarks buildCommonFilters returns.

items.title: CVE-2026-136618
items.summary: Karakeep before 0.35.0 contains an improper access control vulnerability in ManualList.mergeInto that allows list owners to retain collaborator bookmarks by merging shared lists without ownership checks. Owners invoking the lists.merge tRPC procedure create rows not tied to collaborator membership, preserving read access to collaborator bookmarks and assets after the collaborator's access is revoked.

items.title: CVE-2026-136617
items.summary: Shopify async-memcached before 0.11.0 contains a command injection vulnerability in Client::validate_meta_flags that allows attackers to inject extra memcached meta protocol tokens via whitespace in flags. Attackers controlling part of a meta flag can add quiet, opaque, mode or size override tokens to alter operations and desynchronize responses on shared connections.

items.title: CVE-2026-136616
items.summary: COVESA Open1722 before 0.9.8 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in Avtp_Vss_CalcVssPathLength in src/avtp/acf/custom/Vss.c, which reads the INTEROP path-length prefix without checking the declared ACF message length. Attackers can send header-only 12-byte INTEROP-mode VSS frames to trigger reads past the buffer, or prefix values 0xFFFE and 0xFFFF that wrap uint16 lengths and cause Avtp_Vss_SetVssData to overwrite the path area.

items.title: CVE-2026-136615
items.summary: league/commonmark 2.6.0 before 2.10.8 contains a denial of service vulnerability in DelimiterStack::push() that miscounts delimiter runs against the max_delimiters_per_line budget. Attackers submitting Markdown with two long emphasis character runs can produce deeply nested strong elements, causing quadratic rendering time and CPU exhaustion.

items.title: CVE-2026-136451
items.summary: A flaw was found in the Keycloak Operator. Deterministic hashes derived from Kubernetes Secrets are published in generated StatefulSet metadata and in KeycloakOIDCClient status. A user with read access to those resources may be able to recover a low-entropy credential referenced by a Secret, even when Kubernetes RBAC denies the user access to the Secret itself.

items.title: CVE-2026-136448
items.summary: A vulnerability was identified in nliautaud pico-content-editor up to 02d5ad6c820c5050c542ab9505819b5e0a0ba1af. Affected by this vulnerability is the function Uploads::saveFile/Auth::init of the file src/Uploads.php of the component Authorization Subsystem. Such manipulation of the argument PicoContentEditorUpload leads to unrestricted upload. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. This product operates on a rolling release basis, ensuring continuous delivery. Consequently, there are no version details for either affected or updated releases.…

items.title: CVE-2026-124606
items.summary: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory Vulnerability in Cosminexus Component Container. This issue affects Cosminexus Component Container: from 11-20 before 11-70-04.

items.title: CVE-2026-136447
items.summary: A vulnerability was found in browser-use 0.13.13/0.13.14. This impacts the function load_and_migrate_config of the file browser_use/config.py of the component SecurityWatchdog. The manipulation results in improper authorization. The attack requires a local approach. The exploit has been made public and could be used.

items.title: CVE-2026-135813
items.summary: A flaw was found in Red Hat Enterprise Linux's qemu-kvm virtualization software. A privileged user inside a guest virtual machine could use this flaw to make the host QEMU process copy parts of its own memory into the guest's memory, where the attacker could read it. Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to view portions of the host QEMU process memory from within a guest, potentially exposing sensitive information that could aid in further attacks. The highest threat from this vulnerability is to confidentiality.

items.title: CVE-2026-136446
items.summary: A vulnerability has been found in JaguarJack catch-admin up to 5.4.1. This affects the function update of the file modules/Permissions/Http/Controllers/RolesController.php. The manipulation leads to dynamically-determined object attributes. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The identifier of the patch is 3ae60d57ea6840bb33456596ad799b0a39ca94a2. It is recommended to apply a patch to fix this issue.

items.title: CVE-2026-132074
items.summary: The WP Page Builder WordPress plugin through 1.2.8 does not check that the user has permission to edit the targeted post before switching which editor's content is rendered for it, allowing users with a role as low as Subscriber to change what any post or page displays, by switching it between its normal content and its stored page builder content.

items.title: CVE-2026-132048
items.summary: The WP Meta SEO WordPress plugin through 4.5.18 does not check that the user is allowed to edit the post or comment containing an indexed link before rewriting or removing that link, allowing users with a role as low as Contributor to change the target and text of links in, or strip links from, any post or comment.

items.title: CVE-2026-132047
items.summary: The WP Page Builder WordPress plugin through 1.2.8 does not check capabilities or nonces in one of its AJAX actions, allowing any authenticated user, such as a subscriber, to read, add, overwrite and delete the builder's saved sections, and to store arbitrary HTML that is rendered unescaped to an administrator who opens a crafted link.

items.title: CVE-2026-132046
items.summary: The WP Page Builder WordPress plugin through 1.2.8 does not sanitise and escape some of its layout settings before outputting them in pages, and does not check that the user may edit the post being saved, allowing users with a role as low as Contributor to inject stored Cross-Site Scripting payloads into any post or page, including ones they cannot edit.

items.title: CVE-2026-136550
items.summary: A weakness has been identified in Tenda RX3 16.03.13.11_multi. This affects the function fromAdvSetMacMtuWan of the file /goform/AdvSetMacMtuWan. This manipulation of the argument mac causes command injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-136549
items.summary: A security flaw has been discovered in Tenda RX3 16.03.13.11_multi. The impacted element is the function formSetSafeWanWebMan of the file /goform/SetRemoteWebCfg. The manipulation of the argument remoteIp results in command injection. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-16667
items.summary: The Cypress/PSoC6 flash-map backend in boot/cypress/cy_flash_pal/cy_flash_map.c guards every flash access with assert() against the wrong struct field. flash_area_read(), flash_area_write(), and flash_area_erase() check assert(off fa_off) and assert(off + len fa_off), comparing the area-relative off against the partition's absolute base address fa->fa_off instead of its length fa->fa_size. Because fa_off is a large absolute address, realistic out-of-partition offsets pass the check even in a debug build, and under NDEBUG the asserts are removed entirely. items.title: CVE-2026-126536
items.summary: Akaunting 3.3.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the XLSX tax-import workflow. An authenticated Manager can import HTML in a tax name and associate the tax with an item. When an Administrator attempts to disable that tax, Akaunting renders the original stored name in an error notification through Vue v-html, causing attacker-controlled markup to execute within the browser of another authenticated user.

items.title: CVE-2026-136141
items.summary: A vulnerability was identified in Backdrop CMS up to 1.35.2. Affected is the function get_argument of the file core/modules/views/plugins/views_plugin_argument_default_php.inc of the component Views Module. Such manipulation leads to incorrect authorization. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The config-import path enforces no 'use PHP for settings' check while the Views PHP-code argument plugin executes eval() without a permission check, confirming the authorization bypass. The vendor explains: "As per our security advisory policy, no sec…

items.title: CVE-2026-136444
items.summary: A vulnerability was detected in JaguarJack catch-admin up to 5.4.1. The affected element is the function Store/Update of the file modules/User/Http/Controllers/UserController.php of the component User Management. Performing a manipulation results in dynamically-determined object attributes. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The patch is named 3ae60d57ea6840bb33456596ad799b0a39ca94a2. Applying a patch is the recommended action to fix this issue.

items.title: CVE-2026-136146
items.summary: A security flaw has been discovered in vanna-ai vanna 2.0.0/2.0.1/2.0.2. Affected by this vulnerability is the function _load_index of the file src/vanna/integrations/faiss/agent_memory.py of the component FAISS AgentMemory Integration. Performing a manipulation results in deserialization. The attack needs to be approached locally. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: CVE-2026-134875
items.summary: An unencrypted RSA private key for a default HTTPS certificate is included in GeoVision GV-EBD4700 firmware V1.11 (A02-GV-EBD4700_V1.11_2026_10_13.zip) at /program/www/ssl_cert.pem and copied to /config/ssl_cert.pem during initialization. When HTTPS is enabled using the default certificate, a network on-path attacker who obtains the firmware image can use the exposed private key to present an identical certificate and intercept HTTPS traffic. HTTPS is disabled by default . * Only impacts deployments where an administrator enables HTTPS and retains the default certificate. Because the private k…

items.title: CVE-2026-130336
items.summary: Improper Neutralization of Directives in Dynamically Evaluated Code ('Eval Injection') in the HWBridge custom methods command dispatcher (lib/rex/post/hwbridge/ui/console/command_dispatcher/custom_methods.rb) in Rapid7 Metasploit Framework versions prior to 6.5.10 on all platforms allows a malicious or compromised hardware bridge to execute arbitrary code in the msfconsole process via a crafted method_name returned by the /custom_methods endpoint. The injected code runs automatically when the operator connects to the bridge, without the operator invoking any custom command.
