items.summary: MCUboot's PSA-crypto ECDSA adapter parses the RFC 5480 DER signature with parse_signature_from_rfc5480_encoding() in boot/bootutil/include/bootutil/crypto/ecdsa.h, which takes no length argument. bootutil_ecdsa_verify() explicitly discards the signature length ((void)slen;) and the parser walks the encoding using length bytes read from the buffer itself (r_len = sig[3], then a derived s_len), with no check that those offsets stay within the supplied signature. Because this parsing runs before psa_verify_hash(), a malformed signature triggers the read whether or not the signature is valid. In b…

items.title: CVE-2026-16669
items.summary: MCUboot's Espressif port omits zeroization of two sensitive stack buffers in boot/espressif/hal/src/flash_encrypt.c. In check_and_generate_encryption_keys(), the freshly generated XTS-AES flash-encryption key is held in the stack array keys[BLOCKS_NEEDED][32] (flash_encrypt.c:216), written to eFuse via esp_efuse_write_keys(), and the function returns (flash_encrypt.c:243) without scrubbing it. In esp_flash_encrypt_region(), the plaintext flash sector buffer buf (flash_encrypt.c:454) retains the last sector's cleartext at both the success and flash_failed returns. Neither path performs a memset…

items.title: CVE-2026-136628
items.summary: Wails before 2.17.1 on Linux contains an origin validation error in the sendMessageToBackend WebKitGTK handler that allows child-frame scripts to invoke the privileged IPC channel. Attackers controlling content loaded in an iframe can post messages that pass the top-level URI origin check and call bound Go methods and Wails runtime operations.

items.title: CVE-2026-136136
items.summary: A vulnerability was identified in Netis WF2409E up to 20261026. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the file /cgi-bin/skk_set.cgi of the component CGI Interface. The manipulation of the argument app/password/new_pwd_confirm/passwd_set/mode_name/wl_link leads to improper authentication. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: CVE-2026-136135
items.summary: A vulnerability has been found in louislam uptime-kuma up to e7420f8fa546a8baa7ac4bf9d10a32545d4346e0. Affected by this vulnerability is the function disableAPIKey/enableAPIKey of the file server/socket-handlers/api-key-socket-handler.js of the component API Key Management. The manipulation leads to authorization bypass. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The researcher claims to have submitted a GHSA on the repository of the project.

items.title: CVE-2026-123626
items.summary: Akaunting 3.3.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the company localisation date format. An authenticated Manager can store an arbitrary date format. When another authenticated user opens a recurring invoice, Akaunting formats dates with that value and sends the result to a raw HTML schedule description, causing attacker-controlled markup to execute in the victim's Akaunting origin.

items.title: CVE-2026-129839
items.summary: A flaw was found in rsyslog. When processing log entries using certain JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) formatting templates, the service fails to properly escape input composed entirely of quotation marks or backslashes. An attacker who can supply logged input can exploit this issue to generate malformed JSON output, which may cause downstream log ingestion systems and parsers to reject log records.

items.title: CVE-2026-129832
items.summary: A flaw was found in rsyslog. When process identification (PID) rewriting is enabled in the imuxsock module, a local attacker with access to the logging socket can send a crafted log message with an empty tag. This triggers an invalid memory write, causing the logging service to crash and resulting in a Denial of Service (DoS).

items.title: CVE-2026-135328
items.summary: A flaw was found in kubevirt Containerized Data Importer (CDI). The CDI clone controller derives the CommonName of a CDI-CA-signed upload client certificate from the tenant-settable cdi.kubevirt.io/uploadClientName PVC annotation without validation, and the upload server authenticates clients only by certificate CA chain and CommonName string match, with no namespace or PVC binding. A namespace user can obtain a valid client certificate and write arbitrary data into any upload-ready PVC in any namespace whose upload Service is reachable from the cluster network, resulting in cross-namespace in…

items.title: CVE-2026-125734
items.summary: A flaw was found in GStreamer gst-plugins-bad mxfdemux handling of MXF Index Table Segment data. Crafted index metadata can lead to an out-of-range lookup during a seek and terminate the media process. A Fedora 43 test reproduced an assertion-triggered abort. The upstream advisory also notes possible information disclosure, but an attacker-visible leak has not been demonstrated.

items.title: CVE-2026-136445
items.summary: A flaw has been found in JaguarJack catch-admin up to 5.4.1. The impacted element is the function store of the file modules/Permissions/Http/Controllers/RolesController.php. Executing a manipulation can lead to dynamically-determined object attributes. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. This patch is called 3ae60d57ea6840bb33456596ad799b0a39ca94a2. It is best practice to apply a patch to resolve this issue.

items.title: CVE-2026-132271
items.summary: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. Prior to 0.11.0, template rendering is not bounded in size or time. Any signed-up user who can reach a block that takes a format string, such as Fill Text Template or Agent Output, through POST /api/blocks/{id}/execute or the external API's block-execute route, can make the REST API process allocate without bound with one request of a few dozen bytes. items.summary: arXiv:2606.03330v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Literature reveals that a Large Language Model's (LLM) behavior is not only conditioned by its original weights but also its instance-level parameters, such as instructional prompt, sampling configuration or quantization. items.summary: arXiv:2611.23022v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: GPUs are the main platform for large-scale machine learning and power the largest supercomputers. items.summary: arXiv:2611.10403v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present QUASI, a newly conceived class of hash-based, post-quantum-secure protocols that enable a group of parties to produce a publicly verifiable attestation about a pre-validated statement. items.summary: arXiv:2611.31429v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tutors built on large language models (LLMs) are told not to give away answers, but a learner does not have to ask for the answer all at once. items.summary: arXiv:2611.31866v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Prediction markets are becoming an important mechanism for aggregating information and forecasting uncertain real-world events. items.summary: 米司法省が国際的なオンライン詐欺対策の成果を公表した。海外の詐欺拠点の解体支援に加え、不正資産の凍結や詐欺サイトの停止、拠点で働くことを強制された人々の救出にも各国の当局が協力した。

items.title: Physicists just sent an unblockable message through a brick wall using gravity
items.summary: Scientists have successfully transmitted a message through a brick wall using nothing but gravity, an old elevator, and an incredibly sensitive detector. By moving a massive counterweight between two positions, researchers encoded the word "Gravity" into tiny changes in gravitational pull. Unlike Wi-Fi or radio signals, gravity passes through ordinary barriers without being blocked, offering a potentially revolutionary way to communicate.

items.title: AKSHAT Singh commented on merge request !470 at Kali Linux / NetHunter / Build-Scripts / kali-nethunter-kernels
items.summary: Pushed one more commit: kernel updated to v1.2. It fixes a crash when connecting to WPA3 (SAE) networks. The vendor Wi-Fi driver is built for 4.14.141 and a stable update had shifted cfg80211_ops, so the kernel called past the driver's ops table. Nothing else changed: same config, same module paths. The 4 Realtek modules were rebuilt for the fix. Source: https://github.com/ShorterKing/ShorterKing-Nethunter-Kernel-Realme-RMX2020-27/commit/05d2551 (release v1.2). Tested on my RMX2020: connects to a WPA3-only network, no crash.

items.title: CrowdStrike Accelerates the Shift to the Agentic SOC
AI Agent Collisions as Dreams of 1990s Cybersecurity Leads To Solving Wrong Problem - James Robinson - BSW #475
items.summary: As organizations accelerate AI adoption, a new security challenge is emerging: AI Agent Collisions. Autonomous and semi-autonomous agents are increasingly operating across business applications, accessing sensitive data, invoking APIs, and taking actions on behalf of users and organizations. Without visibility into which agents exist, what they can access, and how they interact, organizations risk creating unintended access paths, conflicting actions, data exposure, and gaps in security oversight. James Robinson, CISO at Netskope, joins Business Security Weekly to explore the emerging problem…
